title: InfraRETH
tagline: Artistic NFT movement with a cause. InfreRETH is the first proyect which seeks for equality, education, space expansion, tolerance, through infrared technology.
description:
¿What is the infrared spectrum?

- The first invisible and imperceptible wavelength for the human eye, which curiously shows each individual in their "real" color spectrum, by not highlighting or distinguishing between physical features that certain people could use to divide instead of integrate;  skin color, spots, imperfections, eye color, hair color, type of clothing, accessories, etc.

InfraRETH is the artistic movement  that seeks for equality, unity and inclusion in any of its shapes, an altruistic proyect which main goal is to expand the eth space to the less fortunate, educate them in the process and bring some of them, an opportunity in the future with a series of IRL events, workshops, educating material, scholarships, and giving voice to everyone through its DAO.
InfraRETH implements a rewarding system to each HODLER if the token is linked with WorldCoin (this would give authenticity to your personal InfraRETH picture) bringing more value to your stake and vote inside the InfraRETH DAO, by giving a percentage from every auction (artists, collaborators, celebrities, athletes tokens to be auctioned)  directly delivered and distributed by SuperFluid. Secondary market royalties would also go through SuperFluid to support institutions, individuals, students, altruistic programs, communities that are in situations of marginalization or social inequality, picked by the DAO every certain amount of time.
InfraRETH is the movement that seeks to eradicate filters, with a "filter".

Objective: Increase the peoples participation inside the ethereum ecosystem. To educate, unify and include any individual, focusing in the less privileged people, which could integrate millions in the ETH ecosystem. 
Our motto: altruism, tolerance, respect, education and inclusion.
how_its_made:
This proyect was built right after the team finished listening every expositor in the first day. With a later mockup discussion, we tried to fill as much of the needs from some sponsors and the ethglobal vision of expanding the ethereum ecosystem into a 1Bill user goal. 
We all came into the agreement that if we could integrate the needs of the hackaton with a current social problem, we could grab the interest of many that shared our same altruistic vision.
The project was made with a common vision of taking and expanding the ethereum space to the less fortunate where education, physical limitations, discrimination, social problems present in a dialy basis could be supported by people who already enjoys and privileged themselves with this decentralized, fair, transparent ethereum ecosystem. 
The team feels proud and happy of what we try, developed and accomplished in a couple of days. We think there is a need of change, fair distribution and an environment where sharing is caring.
